synopsis.native: Muškarac samo želi voziti taksi i brinuti se o svojoj slijepoj ženi, ali neočekivani događaji prijete njegovom bezbrižnom postojanju i on se uvlači u prljave živote svojih putnika.
synopsis.english: Goran just wants to drive his taxi and take care of his blind wife Lina. But people close to him have their own agendas and dreams which threaten his carefree existence. In the idyllic surroundings of snow-covered Gorski Kotar, the fiery personalities of the highlanders surface and collide.
